# Mohammad Alqudah, PhD

> Principal Applied Scientist at Microsoft (Collab AI Research). Researcher and practitioner specializing in Large Language Models (LLMs), Agent-Mediated Collaboration, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), and Multimodal Spatiotemporal Machine Learning.

## Core Information
- **Full Name**: Mohammad K. Alqudah, PhD
- **Current Position**: Principal Applied Scientist at Microsoft
- **Organization**: Collab AI Research, Microsoft Corporation
- **Website**: https://malquda1.github.io/
- **Google Scholar**: https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=NmyJed4AAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate
- **Microsoft Research Profile**: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/people/moalqudah/
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammadalqudah/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/malquda1

## Research Interests & Expertise
- **Large Language Models (LLMs)**: Skill description optimization, prompt optimization, instruction tuning, automated evaluation.
- **Agentic AI & Collaboration**: Agent-mediated workflows, cross-user collaboration, intelligent notification delivery.
- **Knowledge Graphs & Memory**: Structured graph memory for augmented retrieval (RAG) and conversational agents.
- **Spatiotemporal Machine Learning**: Multimodal deep learning, physics-informed neural networks, extreme event precursor discovery.
- **Robotics & Industrial ML**: High-frequency real-time inference for semiconductor manufacturing robotics (Applied Materials).
